interface.name: zwlr_screencopy_manager_v1
interface.description: This object is used by clients to request screenshots.

request.name: capture_output
request.description: Capture the next frame of an entire output.

request.name: capture_output_region
request.description: Capture the next frame of an output region.

interface.name: zwlr_screencopy_frame_v1
interface.description: This object represents a single pending frame.

request.name: copy
request.description: Copy the frame to the supplied buffer.

event.name: buffer
event.description: Provides the client with the preferred wl_shm buffer parameters.

event.name: ready
event.description: Called when the frame is copied and ready.

request.name: copy_with_damage

description.summary: copy the frame when it changes

request.description: Copy the frame to the supplied buffer and report damage.

event.name: damage
event.description: Provides the damaged region in buffer coordinates.

event.name: linux_dmabuf
event.description: Provides the client with linux-dmabuf buffer parameters.

event.name: buffer_done

description.summary: all buffer information has been sent

event.description: This event is sent once after all buffer and linux_dmabuf events.
